## Overview

**AMCR File API** serves files and their thumbnails from the AMCR repository.
A file can also have alternative [distributions](#distributions-and-paradata) and paradata, served by the same API.
File URLs can be obtained from the [OAI-PMH API](/oai-pmh/index.qmd) response.
They are in the `soubor/url` element of the response, see example below.
The mimetype of the returned file is in the `Content-Type` response header and its filename in the `Content-Disposition` header; for a distribution, both describe the distribution.

- Base URL for the file API is `https://digiarchiv.aiscr.cz/id/`.

### Example response from OAI-PMH API

Note that the examples on this page access files available to anonymous users (group **A**, see [Access rules](#access-rules)).

#### Samostatný nález / Individual find

This is part of the response of one of the records from `setSpec`: `samostatny_nalez`.

Request: <https://api.aiscr.cz/oai?verb=GetRecord&metadataPrefix=oai_amcr&identifier=https://api.aiscr.cz/id/M-202301215-N00001>

```xml
<amcr:soubor>
	<amcr:id>soub-565387</amcr:id>
	<amcr:path>rest/AMCR/record/M-202301215-N00001/file/aa0cdd95-4bc4-4358-a831-2cf8672a3e4b</amcr:path>
	<amcr:nazev>M202301215N00001F01.JPG</amcr:nazev>
	<amcr:mimetype>image/jpeg</amcr:mimetype>
	<amcr:rozsah>1</amcr:rozsah>
	<amcr:size_mb>0.4693031311</amcr:size_mb>
	<amcr:sha_512>[...]</amcr:sha_512>
	<amcr:url>https://digiarchiv.aiscr.cz/id/M-202301215-N00001/file/aa0cdd95-4bc4-4358-a831-2cf8672a3e4b</amcr:url>
	<amcr:historie>
		[...]
	</amcr:historie>
</amcr:soubor> 
```

#### Dokument / Document

This is part of the response of one of the records from `setSpec`: `dokument`.

Request: <https://api.aiscr.cz/oai?verb=GetRecord&metadataPrefix=oai_amcr&identifier=https://api.aiscr.cz/id/C-TX-198603094>

```xml 
<amcr:soubor>
	<amcr:id>soub-121748</amcr:id>
	<amcr:path>rest/AMCR/record/C-TX-198603094/file/3e28c562-17f6-48dc-b8f5-787d14fb55af</amcr:path>
	<amcr:nazev>CTX198603094.pdf</amcr:nazev>
	<amcr:mimetype>application/pdf</amcr:mimetype>
	<amcr:rozsah>2</amcr:rozsah>
	<amcr:size_mb>0.5069980621</amcr:size_mb>
	<amcr:sha_512>[...]</amcr:sha_512>
	<amcr:url>https://digiarchiv.aiscr.cz/id/C-TX-198603094/file/3e28c562-17f6-48dc-b8f5-787d14fb55af</amcr:url>
	<amcr:historie>
		[...]
	</amcr:historie>
</amcr:soubor> 
```

#### Schema explanation

Below is an explanation of the schema with examples.
Note that namespace prefix `amcr:` is stripped from the element tags.

| Element tag | Description | Example |
|-------------|-------------|---------|
| `<id>` | File ID | `soub-565387` |
| `<path>` | Path to the file | `rest/AMCR/record/M-202301215-N00001/file/aa0cdd95-4bc4-4358-a831-2cf8672a3e4b` |
| `<nazev>` | Filename | `M202301215N00001F01.JPG` |
| `<mimetype>` | Mimetype | `image/jpeg` |
| `<rozsah>` | Page count | `1` |
| `<size_mb>` | Size in MB | `0.4693031311` |
| `<sha_512>` | SHA-512 checksum | `53aaf...` |
| `<url>` | URL to the file | `https://digiarchiv.aiscr.cz/id/M-202301215-N00001/file/aa0cdd95-4bc4-4358-a831-2cf8672a3e4b` |
| `<historie>` | Element with a record of changes | *individual subelements* |

### Distributions and paradata

Besides the original, a file can have alternative **distributions** -- other renditions of the same file, each with its own mimetype and filename.
Each distribution is identified by its path, e.g. `atr/alto-xml`.
The original itself is the distribution `orig`, which is also the default when no distribution is requested.

A distribution can have **paradata**, served as plain text, JSON or other text-based formats.
Paradata are optional; not every distribution has them.

Records of the entities *dokument*, *knihovna_3d* and *samostatny_nalez* can be filtered in the [Digital Archive](https://digiarchiv.aiscr.cz/){.external} search by the facet `soubor_distri`.
Its values are the distribution paths currently available for the record's files: `orig` plus the names of the distributions.

See the [Distributions](#distributions) and [Paradata](#paradata) endpoints below.

### Access rules

Different access rules apply to different files and access groups.
There are four main groups of users:

- **A** (*Anonym*/*Anonymous*) -- anyone on the internet, non-authenticated user;
- **B** (*Badatel*/*Researcher*) -- any user registered in the system;
- **C** (*Archeolog*/*Archaeologist*) -- archaeologist from a licensed organisation;
- **D** (*Archivář*/*Archivist*) -- authorised AMCR archivist.

Furthermore, group **E** (*Administrátor*/*Admin*) exists and no restrictions apply to it.

The rules below apply to the original file and equally to all its distributions, paradata and large thumbnails.
Only small thumbnails are available to anyone, see [Small thumbnails](#small-thumbnails).

::: {.column-page-inset-right}
```{r}
#| tbl-cap: "Basic rules for file access"

read.csv("tabs/access.csv", tryLogical = FALSE) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::everything(), \(x) dplyr::if_else(x == TRUE, "&#x2714;", x)),
                dplyr::across(dplyr::everything(), \(x) dplyr::if_else(x == FALSE, "&#x2718;", x))) |>
  knitr::kable(align = "lllll")
```
:::

> *stav* -- processing state of the record, see [Documentation](https://amcr-help.aiscr.cz/o-systemu/procesy.html){.external} (*in Czech language only*)  
> *pristupnost* -- accessibility of the record, ordered A < B < C < D  
> *my record* -- record created by the user  
> *my organisation record* -- record created by someone from the user's organisation; for a project, a project of the user's organisation  
> *my organisation's project* -- individual find recorded under a project of the user's organisation  
> *handed over to my organisation* -- individual find handed over to the user's organisation (`samostatny_nalez/predano_organizace`), in any processing state  
> *knihovna_3d* -- records of the 3D library are documents; the `//dokument/soubor` row applies to them

### Authentication

#### Basic authentication

Only basic access authentication using AMCR credentials (username and password) is supported.

::: {.callout-tip}
User registration is available here: [https://amcr.aiscr.cz/accounts/register/](https://amcr.aiscr.cz/accounts/register/){.external}. 
:::

##### cURL example

```sh 
curl -u <username> "https://digiarchiv.aiscr.cz/id/M-202301215-N00001/file/aa0cdd95-4bc4-4358-a831-2cf8672a3e4b/thumb" \
    -o thumbnail.png
```

#### Authentication API 

- Authentication using bearer token returned by the AMCR Authentication API is **not** (yet) supported.

### Variables 

| Name | Type | Description | Required | Example |
|------|------|-------------|----------|---------|
| `digiarchiv_url` | *string* | Base URL for the API | `true` | `https://digiarchiv.aiscr.cz` |
| `ident_cely` | *string* | Full identifier of the record | `true` | `M-202301215-N00001`, `C-TX-198603094` |
| `file_id` | *string* | Unique identifier of the file | `true` | `aa0cdd95-4bc4-4358-a831-2cf8672a3e4b`, `3e28c562-17f6-48dc-b8f5-787d14fb55af` |
| `page` | *integer* | Specific page number | `true` for the page thumbnail endpoint | `1`, `2` |
| `dist` | *string* | Path of the distribution, see [Distributions and paradata](#distributions-and-paradata) | `false`, defaults to `orig` | `orig`, `atr/alto-xml` |


## Endpoints

All endpoints share one path pattern: the file path followed by at most one of the suffixes below.

```text
/id/{ident_cely}/file/{file_id}                     original file
/id/{ident_cely}/file/{file_id}/{dist}              distribution of the file
/id/{ident_cely}/file/{file_id}/thumb               small thumbnail
/id/{ident_cely}/file/{file_id}/thumb-large         large thumbnail of the first page
/id/{ident_cely}/file/{file_id}/thumb/page/{page}   large thumbnail of a page
/id/{ident_cely}/file/{file_id}/paradata[/{dist}]   paradata of a distribution
```

The segments `thumb`, `thumb-large`, `thumb/page/{page}` and `paradata` are reserved.
Any other path segment after `{file_id}` is resolved as a distribution of the file, `orig` being the explicit form of the original.
A request for a distribution that the file does not have returns `404 Not Found`.

### Small thumbnails

`GET` method for thumbnails of images and documents. 
In case of multipage documents (i.e. value of `<rozsah>` tag > 1), this method returns its first page.
Thumbnails are in **PNG** file format, with the maximum **size of 100x100 px**.
All small thumbnails are available without authentication.

- Method: `GET`
- Endpoint: `/id/{ident_cely}/file/{file_id}/thumb`

#### Example requests

##### cURL

```sh
curl "https://digiarchiv.aiscr.cz/id/M-202301215-N00001/file/aa0cdd95-4bc4-4358-a831-2cf8672a3e4b/thumb" \
    -o thumbnail.png
```

##### BASH script

Prompts for username and password.

```{.bash filename="thumb.sh"} 
#!/bin/bash

# Prompt for username
read -p "Enter username: " username

# Prompt for password securely
read -sp "Enter password: " password
echo 

# Curl command with authentication and output
curl -u "$username:$password" \
    "https://digiarchiv.aiscr.cz/id/M-202301215-N00001/file/aa0cdd95-4bc4-4358-a831-2cf8672a3e4b/thumb" \
    -o thumbnail.png
```

##### Python script

Prompts for username and password and checks status code of the response.

```{.python filename="thumb.py"}
#!/usr/bin/env python 

import requests
import getpass

# Base URL
base_url = "https://digiarchiv.aiscr.cz"

# File download parameters
ident_cely = "M-202301215-N00001"
file_id = "aa0cdd95-4bc4-4358-a831-2cf8672a3e4b"

# Prompt for username and password
username = input("Enter username: ")
password = getpass.getpass("Enter password: ")

# Download thumbnail
response = requests.get(
    f"{base_url}/id/{ident_cely}/file/{file_id}/thumb",
    auth=(username, password),
)

# Save file if file download was successful
if response.status_code == 200:
    # Save the file
    with open(f"{file_id}.png", "wb") as file:
        file.write(response.content)
    print("Thumbnail downloaded successfully.")
else:
    print(f"Failed to download thumbnail. Status code: {response.status_code}")
    print(f"Response: {response.text}")

```


### Large thumbnails

`GET` method to request large thumbnail of any page in the document.
Large thumbnails are in **JPEG** file format in case of (textual) documents and **PNG** file format in case of images (photographs), with the maximum **size of 800x800 px**.
An image has a single page, so for images only `page` = `1` is valid; any other page returns `404 Not Found`.
Large thumbnails follow the access rules of the original file, see section [Access rules](#access-rules) above.

- Method: `GET`
- Endpoint: `/id/{ident_cely}/file/{file_id}/thumb/page/{page}`

#### Example requests

##### cURL 

```sh 
curl "https://digiarchiv.aiscr.cz/id/C-TX-198603094/file/3e28c562-17f6-48dc-b8f5-787d14fb55af/thumb/page/2" \
    -o thumbnail.jpeg
```


### Large thumbnail of the first page

`GET` method to request the large thumbnail of the first page of a document or of an image.
The thumbnail is in **PNG** file format.
It follows the access rules of the original file, see section [Access rules](#access-rules) above.

- Method: `GET`
- Endpoint: `/id/{ident_cely}/file/{file_id}/thumb-large`

#### Example requests

##### cURL

```sh
curl "https://digiarchiv.aiscr.cz/id/C-TX-198603094/file/3e28c562-17f6-48dc-b8f5-787d14fb55af/thumb-large" \
    -o thumbnail.png
```


### Original files

`GET` method to request original files.
Without authentication, only some original files are available, see section [Access rules](#access-rules) above.

- Method: `GET`
- Endpoint: `/id/{ident_cely}/file/{file_id}`


#### Example requests

##### cURL

```sh
curl "https://digiarchiv.aiscr.cz/id/M-202301215-N00001/file/aa0cdd95-4bc4-4358-a831-2cf8672a3e4b" \
    -o file.jpeg
```


### Distributions

`GET` method to request a distribution of a file, see [Distributions and paradata](#distributions-and-paradata).
The `Content-Type` and `Content-Disposition` response headers carry the mimetype and filename of the requested distribution.
The distribution `orig` returns the original file, i.e. the same response as the [Original files](#original-files) endpoint.
A distribution that the file does not have returns `404 Not Found`.
Distributions follow the access rules of the original file, see section [Access rules](#access-rules) above.

- Method: `GET`
- Endpoint: `/id/{ident_cely}/file/{file_id}/{dist}`

#### Example requests

##### cURL

```sh
curl "https://digiarchiv.aiscr.cz/id/{ident_cely}/file/{file_id}/atr/alto-xml" \
    -o distribution.xml
```


### Paradata

`GET` method to request the paradata of a distribution, see [Distributions and paradata](#distributions-and-paradata).
Paradata are always returned as plain text (`Content-Type: text/plain`).
The form without `{dist}` returns the paradata of the original, i.e. the same response as `paradata/orig`.
Paradata follow the access rules of the original file, see section [Access rules](#access-rules) above.

- Method: `GET`
- Endpoint: `/id/{ident_cely}/file/{file_id}/paradata` -- paradata of the original (`orig`)
- Endpoint: `/id/{ident_cely}/file/{file_id}/paradata/{dist}` -- paradata of the distribution `{dist}`

#### Example requests

##### cURL

```sh
curl "https://digiarchiv.aiscr.cz/id/{ident_cely}/file/{file_id}/paradata/atr/alto-xml" \
    -o paradata.txt
```

## Notes

### Error Handling

#### Common Error Codes

| Code | Description | Possible Cause |
|------|-------------|----------------|
| 401 | Unauthorized | Invalid credentials |
| 403 | Forbidden | Insufficient permissions |
| 404 | Not Found | Invalid identifier, file ID or distribution |
| 429 | Too Many Requests | Too frequent requests, see [Rate limiting](#rate-limiting) |

### Rate limiting

File downloads are rate limited per client: parallel requests are not allowed and there must be 1 second or more between requests.
The limit applies identically to original files, distributions and paradata.

A request over the limit returns `429 Too Many Requests` with a `Retry-After` header stating, in whole seconds, how long to wait before retrying.
Wait at least that long and do not send requests in parallel.
